prior_orchestrator_verdict.rationale: All three lenses ran with the spec and story present. All 5 story ACs pass. Two spec items are partial: the backfill allocation path has no zero-share warning (G5), and the resync seam test does not assert the value seeded into the shared child budget (G6). 3 findings deferred as pre-existing: (1) toggle-on pushes stale stored rows when FIXED overrides already exceed the budget, an invalid state the API rejects on save; (2) infinite or huge budget amounts are not range-checked before Decimal quantize, same as the old code; (3) the UI does not reload budgets after the enforcement toggle in the Edit Project modal, the same staleness that already affects allocated display values. 17 findings dismissed after verification (session commit exists; the shared-child upsert is DB-only; the allocation columns are NOT NULL Float; enforce_limit is already bound; the group list is scoped to one project; the floor rule and the no-migration choice are decided in the spec).

findings.title: Backfill split lacks zero-share warning
findings.problem: _create_backfilled_project_budget calls project_budget_service._allocate_equal and seeds the shared child, but never calls _log_zero_equal_share, so spec G5's allocation-time WARNING is missing on this path.
findings.impact: When a legacy budget is migrated with enforcement on and the floored share is $0.00, members cannot spend and nothing is logged on the backend.
findings.recommendation: Call project_budget_service._log_zero_equal_share(project_name, budget_id, (r.allocated_max_budget for r in allocation_rows), enforce_limit) right after the _allocate_equal call, and add a seam test.

findings.title: Resync seam test omits seeded value
findings.problem: test_resync_logs_warning_when_equal_share_is_zero patches _ensure_shared_child_budget but asserts only the warning log, not the per_member_max_budget/per_member_soft_budget seeded into the shared child, which spec G6 requires for the resync seam.
findings.impact: A regression that seeds the shared LiteLLM budget with a non-uniform or remainder value on rebalance would go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Capture the _ensure_shared_child_budget mock and assert per_member_max_budget == 0.0 and per_member_soft_budget == 0.0 for the $0.30/70 case.

CR-002: the resync seam test now asserts the shared child is seeded with 0.0/0.0; the test fake now mutates the updated row like the real repository. The fix-up diff only adds one log call plus tests, so no new high-risk surface; 232 budget and runtime-sync tests pass.
